text:
maria: quick heads-up — lyra20b int4 canary (v0.9.1-quant) showing a small but consistent quality drop on long-context prompts and intermittent OOMs during multi-turn sessions. traces linked.

sam: same here. droprate ~2.7% vs 1.1% baseline on long-chat eval. OOMs line up with sessions hitting max_new_tokens=512.

quinn: wait — did the route default change? I thought max_new_tokens default was 256.

maria: route had no explicit max_new_tokens. recent service patch bumped implicit default to 512 for new model profiles, which exposed int4 fragmentation.

ops: deploy-bot: Canary deploy lyra20b-int4 v0.9.1-quant -> pool-canary-3 completed at 1701234700 :white_check_mark:

quinn: sample OOM log:
```
[2024-10-28T21:12:47Z] cudaMalloc OOM
model=lyra20b-int4 shard=1 seq=4096 max_new=512
KVCache reserve attempt failed; evict candidates: 0
alloc prefetched kv pages -> failed
```

sasha: KV eviction didn't fire. eviction threshold might have tightened after quant packing change; int4 kernels change chunking.

sam: hypothesis: higher max_new_tokens -> larger ephemeral allocs -> more KV churn -> fragmentation and failing cudaMalloc. Two mitigations: lower max_new_tokens on the route OR soft-evict before alloc.

maria: local test with max_new_tokens=256 + soft_eviction=true + microbatch=1: no OOMs in 200 long-chat sims. quality drop persists (+1.5% vs baseline) so regression partly quant related.

quinn: route snippet used (for reference):
```json
{
  "route": "lyra20b-int4-canary",
  "model_variant": "lyra20b-int4-v0.9.1-quant",
  "defaults": {
    "max_new_tokens": 256,
    "microbatch_size": 1,
    "soft_eviction": true,
    "prefetch": "balanced"
  }
}
```

sasha: also enable kv_trim_interval=30s on canary nodes to free orphaned KV segments; that helped similar warmup churn before.

ops: applying kv_trim_interval=30s now, monitoring.

deploy-bot: Update applied to lyra20b-int4-canary at 1701234810 by ops.

sam: quality eval vs v0.8.7 (fp16 baseline) shows small consistent drop on planning prompts—likely per-layer rounding + EOS handling in int4.

quinn: propose two experiments: (A) hybrid quant (last 2 transformer layers fp16) (B) fp16 LM head only. measure droprate and memory/latency delta.

maria: plan: 1) immediate config change (max_new_tokens=256 + soft_eviction + kv_trim) to stop OOMs; 2) run benches: hybrid-tail-2 and head-fp16; 3) if hybrid recovers quality with <6% memory cost, promote v0.9.2-hybrid canary.

sasha: I'll push a focused eval set for long-plan prompts to /evals/lyra20b/longplan.

ops: note—if lowering route defaults, document canary override in console and alert support so customers aren't surprised.

maria: will add console banner explaining temporary limit and link to traces.

sam: bench command (example):
```bash
bench-run --model lyra20b --variant int4 --hybrid-layers tail:2 --evals /evals/lyra20b/longplan --out /tmp/bench-hybrid.json
```

quinn: queuing both runs and enabling token-level drop logging to pinpoint if truncation or low-confidence.

maria: actionables: [ops] monitor kv_trim + soft_eviction; [team] run hybrid + head-fp16 benches; [sasha] push evals; [maria] console banner + support note. reconvene in ~2h with results.

ops: observed p95 latency +14ms after kv_trim, likely background compaction. will watch.

maria: uploaded traces: https://internal.artifacts/lyra20b/canary-traces/1701234567.zip

deploy-bot: Alert: canary pool usage +8% after config change at 1701234860.

quinn: pausing here until benches finish. will post outputs back in this thread.

sasha: cc @matt (model-owner) for quality regression once benches are in.

maria: thanks all, will ping when benches complete.
